blocks.text: Beta-elimination woh reaction hai jis mein beta carbon (halogen wale carbon ke saath wala carbon) ka hydrogen atom aur halogen atom hat'te hain. Yeh tab hota hai jab base beta hydrogen par hamla kare; halogen saath ya baad mein nikalta hai, aur substitution product ki bajaye alkene banti hai. Elimination substitution ke saath saath hota aur aksar us se muqabla karta hai. Substitution ki tarah yeh bhi do mechanisms, E2 ya E1, par chal sakta hai.

items: E2 (bimolecular): base beta hydrogen par hamla karta aur leaving group usi waqt nikalta jab C=C double bond banta hai, aik qadam mein. Raftaar halogenoalkane aur base dono par munhasir: rate = k[halogenoalkane][base], second order.

blocks.alt: Base- se bromoethane ke beta H ki taraf mura teer, us C-H bond se C-C bond ki taraf mura teer, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mura teer; natija ethene + H-Base + Br-.
blocks.caption: E2 mechanism: bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 81 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Base beta carbon ka H kheenchta hai, us C-H bond ke electrons do carbons ke darmiyan doosra bond (C=C) banate hain, aur isi waqt Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikal jata hai. Kitab ke E2 khaake mein Br ke nikalne ka teesra mura teer chhapa nahi; hamare khaake mein woh shamil hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke E2 khaake mein C-Br bond se Br tak ka mura teer (curly arrow) nahi chhapa; Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikalta hai, is liye khaake mein yeh teer shamil kiya gaya hai.

items: E1 (unimolecular): SN1 ki tarah pehla qadam substrate ki sust ionisation se carbocation; doosre qadam mein base beta hydrogen hata kar alkene deta. Raftaar sirf halogenoalkane par munhasir: rate = k[halogenoalkane].

blocks.alt: Qadam 1: 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (C par delta+, Br par delta-) equilibrium teeron (slow) se 3 darje (tertiary) ka carbocation + Br- deta hai. Qadam 2: Base- se beta H ki taraf mura teer, aur us C-H bond se musbat carbon wale bond ki taraf mura teer, tez (fast), 2-methylpropene + H-Base.
blocks.caption: E1 mechanism: 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (kitab ke PDF safha 81 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke E1 qadam 1 mein carbocation ke aik methyl group ko 'CH2' likha gaya hai; sahi CH3 hai (teeno groups CH3 hain), jaisa hamare khaake mein hai. Qadam 2 mein base beta H hatata aur C-H ke electrons musbat carbon ki taraf ja kar C=C banate hain.
Primary halogenoalkanes aam taur par E2 aur tertiary halogenoalkanes E1 par chalte hain, jab ke secondary halogenoalkanes solvent ke mutabiq koi bhi dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane, (CH3)3C-CH2Br, elimination karta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi: beta carbon, C(CH3)3, par koi hydrogen nahi, is liye base ke hatane ko koi beta hydrogen nahi.

items: Beta-elimination beta-H aur X hata kar alkene deta.
E2: aik qadam, rate = k[RX][base]; E1: carbocation ke zariye, rate = k[RX].
Primary: E2; tertiary: E1; secondary: dono.
